consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in open deck at night, lit passenger lounge, wake behind the ship; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with night navy, cabin yellow, wake white, far-light orange; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
